newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia in class action suit.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia in class action suit.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said on Monday that certain shareholders have filed a class action suit against the company, and that the complaint alleged damages of an unspecified amount.
The paging and personal communications services provider said it believed the suit was without merit and that it intended to defend its position vigorously.

MobileMedia was not immediately available to comment further on the nature of the suit, which it said was filed in a New Jersey District Court on behalf of shareholders who bought MobileMedia common stock between August 2, 1995 and September 27, 1996.
